limitations: Live run 2026-09-26 on origin/main ce39721, tarball aiur-khala-0.1.0.tgz, Claude Code 2.1.283, agent-launched in tmux (not an ordinary user-started CLI), user default settings (auto mode), no permission bypass.

Acknowledgement is not recorded: the internal Claude read port opens its inbox without a recordAcknowledgement callback and the launcher composes no receipt ledger or projection, so the owner receipts route stayed empty. Negative scenarios hold at the inbox cursor, where acknowledgement happens, and hold vacuously for receipt facts.
Idle wake is not claimed for this route. The owner view reports idle delivery unproven and the watcher stays off, so an idle session receives messages at its next turn.

Wrong token is not reachable live: no agent tool or hook op accepts a token. Retained token bytes were checked absent from the Claude transcripts and captures. Wrong generation is covered offline only.
A session that re-requests access after Stop gets its original revoked request back, because the default operation ID is per session and target. The rejoin used an explicit new operation ID.
A newly admitted binding received every earlier channel message on its first pull, although the access request carried history none.
Setup ran with a PATH that omitted Codex and OpenCode, to keep shared Aiur worker config untouched.
Offline conformance is component evidence, never a support claim.
